summary: Permission Model, Sessions, and Document Vault Testing - All 17 tests passed (100%). Verified tiered permission system (super_admin > admin > user), scoped visibility, plan management, session creation on login, and local file upload.

register_permissions.super_admin_creates_user: PASS - super_admin can create role=viewer/user accounts

register_permissions.admin_blocked_from_creating_admin: PASS - admin gets 403 when trying to create role=admin
register_permissions.user_blocked_from_creating_anyone: PASS - user (role=viewer) gets 403 on all register attempts

list_admins_permissions.admin_sees_enterprise_members: PASS - admin sees scoped enterprise members
list_admins_permissions.user_gets_403: PASS - user role gets 403 on list

plan_management_permissions.super_admin_changes_any_plan: PASS - super_admin can change any account's plan
plan_management_permissions.admin_changes_user_plan: PASS - admin can change user-level account plans
plan_management_permissions.admin_blocked_from_changing_admin_plan: PASS - admin gets 403 when changing admin plans

delete_permissions.admin_deletes_user: PASS - admin can delete user-level accounts
delete_permissions.admin_blocked_from_deleting_admin: PASS - admin gets 403 when deleting admin accounts

session_management.login_creates_session: PASS - POST /api/admin/login creates session record in admin_sessions

seed_data_creation: Created test users with prefix TEST_* during test execution
context_for_next_testing_agent: All permission model tests pass. Tiered system: super_admin can do everything, admin can manage users but not admins, users (viewer/collections) cannot create/manage anyone. Sessions are created on login and returned by GET /api/sessions. Document vault uses local filesystem at DOC_VAULT_PATH (default /opt/paylock/documents).
